doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Playing solo at Elmer's on North State Street
summary: Elmer's was across from the Chicago Theatre; the clientele was classier and she drew attention from theatre musicians.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Tell me about Elmer’s on North State Street.
It was a bar. Everybody came to it. We were right across from the Chicago Theatre. Right across from the State and Lake.
And were you playing by yourself, with a trio?
How did that differ from the gig at Costello’s?
It didn’t differ, just some more work.
Maybe in class. And I began to get more attention. I would get musicians from the Chicago Theatre and from the State and Lake.
